data.raw_text:
Ehrran Montoya shares the design process and inspiration behind Brigiding’s ‘RuVeal Yourself Runway’ look for Drag Race Philippines: Slaysian Royale.

“Starting with a fierce black latex look — gloves, cape, and fiery tulle layers that spark with life — she transforms into a show-stopping corseted pageant gown ablaze in hues of fire. Hand-crafted feathers meet real feathers from her past runway, symbolizing rebirth, resilience, and soaring even higher.

A Phoenix. A Sarimanok. A Brigiding reborn. 🐦‍🔥🔥✨” (Ehrran Montoya via Instagram)

📸 ehrranmontoya
